stages.title: Close caseworker office
stages.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production panoramic background for a polished side-scrolling browser runner game
Primary request: Create one cohesive close-up Austrian tax-office office-and-records room at night, seen as a side-on architectural cutaway very near the camera/player. This is a compact working room, not a hallway: desks, office chairs tucked behind desks, filing cabinets, densely filled folder shelving, midground doors and glass partitions, and fluorescent ceiling fixtures all belong to the same continuous environment.
Scene/backdrop: empty public administration office after hours, calm slightly uncanny night atmosphere, coherent continuous room across the full width.
Style/medium: premium stylized 2.5D game environment illustration with painterly 3D-like forms, crisp professional finish, not photorealistic.
Composition/framing: very wide cinematic landscape, side-on perpendicular elevation with shallow depth and no distant central vanishing point. Furniture and shelving should feel large and close to the viewer, occupying the upper and middle portions. Reserve the entire lower 22 percent as a completely unobstructed, straight, level dark running lane from left edge to right edge. Keep desks, chairs, cabinets, partition posts, boxes, and all props entirely behind and above that lane. Make both outer edges visually calm and compatible with alternating mirrored horizontal repetition: no cropped dominant object, doorway, sign, or strong diagonal at either edge.
Lighting/mood: moody midnight blue, slate, muted teal, and restrained warm desk-lamp accents. A rhythmic set of visible cool-white fluorescent fixtures along the ceiling; soft pools of light, readable silhouettes, controlled contrast, no harsh flash.
Materials/textures: practical laminated desks, metal filing cabinets, paper folders, glass partitions, acoustic ceiling, subtly worn institutional surfaces.
Text (verbatim): Include one small professional wall plaque with exactly “Finanzamt Österreich” (F-i-n-a-n-z-a-m-t space Ö-s-t-e-r-r-e-i-c-h), but keep it scenic and not dominant. Tiny optional details: a binder marked “BAO”, a small calendar note “31.12.”, a coffee mug marked “§”, and one tiny friendly blue dog silhouette sticker. Exact typography will also be reinforced in deterministic post-processing.
Constraints: no people, no animals, no human silhouettes; lower running lane totally clear edge-to-edge; all furniture in midground; close compact room scale; one continuous seamless-feeling scene; stable ground geometry; readable on mobile; plausible when alternating with a horizontally mirrored copy.
Avoid: broad corridor, distant hallway, central vanishing point, huge atrium, multiple disconnected rooms, hard visual scene boundaries, obstacles in the lower lane, foreground clutter, fisheye, tilted floor, fire, smoke, destruction, Vienna landmarks, unrelated logos, watermarks, gibberish signage, extra readable text, copied existing game assets.
